item.title: Somerton house fire: 1 man found dead; neighbor rescues 85-year-old woman
item.description: Deputy Chief Thomas Gallagher of the Philadelphia Fire Department said a fire broke out at a single-family home in the Somerton neighborhood Monday afternoon, leaving one person presumed dead and two others hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries. item.title: Council Rock elementary aide accused of soliciting child sexual abuse material in Bucks County
item.description: A Bucks County elementary aide was arrested and fired on multiple child exploitation charges this week.

item.title: Sean Mannion hired as Eagles’ new offensive coordinator
item.description: Mannion will replace Kevin Patullo, who the team parted ways with earlier this month.

item.title: 19-year-old killed in Southwest Philadelphia, police say suspect stole 2 bikes
item.description: A 19-year-old man, identified by his family as Russell Williams Jr., was shot and killed in Southwest Philadelphia overnight while walking home from school, according to police.

item.title: Philadelphia EMT charged with allegedly stealing cash from deceased woman in Center City
item.description: A Philadelphia EMT is facing charges after prosecutors say he stole cash from a deceased woman’s wallet in October while responding to a call in Center City.

item.title: Arctic cold grips Philadelphia as storm brings minimal snow, high winds
item.description: The region remains in a deep freeze as dangerous wind chills and record cold temperatures continue, according to FOX 29’s weather team.

item.title: Microchip helps Wisconsin man find lost dog in Philadelphia after 4 years
item.description: A man and his long-lost dog were reunited at ACCT Philly after four years apart, following a cross-country drive and a lucky microchip match.

item.title: Police: Man hospitalized after gun used in Kensington parking dispute
item.description: Police say a fight over a parking spot in Kensington ended with a 45-year-old man being hit in the head with a gun and two people arrested Monday afternoon.
